About our brand and products:
OPTIMACY is a premium supplement brand powered by a proprietary and advanced liposomal technology to ensure maximum absorption and real results. Our products support energy, recovery, sleep, stress, and overall wellness — trusted by elite athletes and everyday achievers alike.

What makes us different:
We combine both clinically-studied liposomes and ingredients with award-winning scientific formulation. Our brand is backed by NFL legend Terrell Owens, offering unmatched credibility in the wellness space.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn 15% commission on every sale with no cap, plus up to $100 in launch bonuses during their first 60 days. We offer a 30-day cookie window and fast payouts via PayPal.

How to promote us:
Use exclusive TO-branded content, social media posts, video assets, and product education guides. We provide everything you need to share confidently and convert effectively.

Other information:
We welcome wellness enthusiasts, creators, influencers, and high-performance advocates. Whether you’re just getting started or have an established audience, OPTIMACY gives you premium products, real support, and strong earning potential.

OPTIMACY Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions
Operated by APEX Sourcing LLC
Last Updated: 8/2/2025

1. Welcome & Acceptance
Welcome to the OPTIMACY Affiliate Program (the “Program”), operated by APEX Sourcing LLC, doing business as “OPTIMACY.” By enrolling or participating, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. You must be 18 years or older, or have legal capacity to enter into binding agreements. APEX Sourcing LLC reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion.

2. Definitions

  • Affiliate: The individual or entity approved to promote OPTIMACY products.

  • Qualified Sale: A completed customer purchase made via your unique affiliate link, not canceled or refunded within the return window.

  • Commission: Compensation earned by the Affiliate for Qualified Sales, subject to the terms below.

3. Enrollment & Approval
Enrollment is subject to review and approval by APEX Sourcing LLC. We may request information about your promotional channels (e.g., websites, social media accounts). Applications that promote adult content, hate speech, misinformation, or violate intellectual property law will be rejected or removed.

4. Promotion Guidelines
Affiliates may only promote OPTIMACY using brand-approved assets and must:

  • Never make medical claims about OPTIMACY products.

  • Always comply with FTC guidelines regarding affiliate disclosures.

  • Refrain from promoting on inappropriate or non-compliant channels (e.g., adult, gambling, or deceptive traffic).

  • Paid advertising using brand terms (e.g., “OPTIMACY,” “Terrell Owens,” product names) is prohibited without prior written approval.

  • Misrepresentation or false claims will result in immediate termination.

5. Commission & Tracking

  • Standard commission: 15% on all Qualified Sales.

  • 30-day cookie window, last-click attribution.

  • Self-referrals or personal purchases through your affiliate link are not eligible for commission.

6. Payment & Returns

  • Commissions are paid via PayPal 30 days after a Qualified Sale, provided the affiliate has met the minimum payout threshold of $50.

  • If an affiliate’s account balance is below $50, the balance will carry over until the threshold is met.

  • If an affiliate account remains inactive for 6 consecutive months and has not reached the $50 threshold, any accrued commissions may be forfeited and the account deactivated at the discretion of APEX Sourcing LLC.

  • OPTIMACY offers a 45-day return policy. If a product is returned after a commission has been paid, that amount may be deducted from future earnings.

  • APEX Sourcing LLC reserves the right to adjust, withhold, or revoke commissions in cases of fraud, self-referrals, or policy violations.

7. Intellectual Property & Confidentiality

  • All OPTIMACY trademarks, logos, and content remain the exclusive property of APEX Sourcing LLC.

  • Affiliates may not alter or misrepresent brand assets.

  • Any confidential campaign information (e.g., unreleased products or media) must not be shared externally.

8. Term & Termination
This agreement remains in effect unless terminated by either party. APEX Sourcing LLC reserves the right to remove an affiliate from the program at any time, with or without cause, especially in cases of policy violations. Pending commissions may be forfeited upon breach of terms.

9. Modifications to Terms
APEX Sourcing LLC may update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Changes will be posted and emailed to affiliates. Continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of any changes.

10. Limitation of Liability
APEX Sourcing LLC provides this Program “as-is” and is not liable for any indirect damages, lost revenue, or earnings beyond paid commissions. Maximum liability is limited to $100.

11. Governing Law
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local laws through negotiation or legal arbitration if necessary.

12. Contact
For questions regarding this program, please contact:
APEX Sourcing LLC (dba OPTIMACY)
📧 info@myoptimacy.com
🌐 www.myoptimacy.com
